pattern.short_summary: A structure declared in advance — a schema, slot set, section skeleton, or typed taxonomy — determines the form the model's output must take.
pattern.definition: A structure declared in advance — a schema, slot set, section skeleton, or typed taxonomy — determines the form the model's output must take. Generation is validated against or rendered into that structure rather than emitted as free text. The structure exists at the type level: it applies to every output the system produces, not just this one.
pattern.structural_signature: A named structure with enumerated parts (fields, sections, component types, category labels) is defined independently of any single generation and is stored in the system. The generator's output is emitted into, checked against, or parsed by that structure, and downstream rendering is per-part: each part gets its own visual slot, colour, or handle. Outputs that do not conform are corrected or rejected before display.
